text: Ketchup, pickles, cereal, sock. Ymamot Creation!
where: Ymamot Creation: little Amy in the flashback (Grace's voice)
script: [gleeful six-year-old announcing a recipe, bossy and proud, quick; Ymamot is said YAH-mah-mott] Ketchup, pickles, cereal, sock. [beat] Ymamot Creation!

text: Heading out? I can come. I have a tool belt, a flashlight and a strong opinion about whatever you're about to fight.
where: Justin offers to join the party (Gregori house talk)
script: [thick New York accent, easygoing, friendly, goofy proud dad] Heading out? I can come. I have a tool belt, a flashlight and a strong opinion about whatever you're about to fight.

text: Great. Let me grab my jacket. And the ladder. Don't ask about the ladder.
script: [thick New York accent, warm, cheerful, a little distracted] Great. Let me grab my jacket. And the ladder. Don't ask about the ladder.

text: No problem. The hallway light won't finish itself. It's been almost done since June.
where: Justin when Tom says not right now
script: [thick New York accent, easygoing, dry, a little rueful] No problem. The hallway light won't finish itself. It's been almost done since June.

text: Somebody has to tag out. I'll wait. I'll be on the ladder.
where: Justin when the party is full and Tom must swap someone out
script: [thick New York accent, easygoing, relaxed, amused] Somebody has to tag out. I'll wait. I'll be on the ladder.

where: Foot Tap, the big spread-arms scream frame (held 1.1 s), the hit lands on it
script: [thick New York accent, a huge drawn-out scream of pain, arms spread, red in the face, as long and loud as the word allows] OOOUUUCH!!!!!!

where: Foot Tap, 2.8s, Rose taps Justin's sneaker toe (also Grace when Rose is down)
script: [tiny, careful, barely a whisper, mischievous] Tap.
